description.en: Territory claimed (and referred to by the UN General Assembly) as the Palestinian territory occupied since 1967 - West Bank, East Jerusalem, Gaza Strip. A claim/recognition footprint, not an area of control.
description.ar: الإقليم المُطالَب به (وأشارت إليه الجمعية العامة للأمم المتحدة) بوصفه الأرض الفلسطينية المحتلة منذ 1967 - الضفة الغربية والقدس الشرقية وقطاع غزة. بصمة مطالبة/اعتراف لا منطقة سيطرة.
description.he: השטח הנתבע (ושאליו מתייחסת עצרת האו״ם) כשטח הפלסטיני הכבוש מאז 1967 - הגדה המערבית, מזרח ירושלים ורצועת עזה. טביעת רגל של תביעה/הכרה, לא אזור שליטה.

sources.quote: the Palestinian territory occupied since 1967, including East Jerusalem
which encompasses the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Gaza Strip

notes.en: The 1988 declaration itself did not define borders. Renderers should style this slice as a claim, distinct from the PA's and Hamas's areas of actual administration. Modelling note: a claim, drawn as an outline only; control on the ground is shown by the Palestinian Authority, Hamas-led administration and Israeli military government records.
